verdict.rationale: Heap is a product-analytics SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The llms.txt file and the in-product Sense Chat are adjacent features, not an agent-connectable MCP server, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
